Jul 2025 — Present

Regask

Solution Architect

Go · Kubernetes · Knative · Azure · Temporal · Redis · Crossplane

  • Redesigned high-traffic services around Knative and event-driven patterns on Kubernetes, increasing throughput by 40% and reducing infrastructure costs by 30%.
  • Implemented Redis write-behind caching, scaling per-service write throughput from 10K to 100K requests per second while reducing database load.
  • Building the authorization server connecting the application suite to Claude through MCP, with scoped, per-user access to internal services.
  • Introduced Temporal durable execution and event orchestration for the AI workflow builder, allowing multi-step agent flows to resume after restarts.
  • Instrumented all microservices with Grafana Cloud, establishing performance baselines, SLOs, and anomaly alerts.
  • Built a local service-mesh simulator that reduced high-priority issue resolution time by 20%, and rolled out Backstage to unify the service catalogue, development workflow, and releases.
  • Led Terraform adoption and consolidated Kafka, database, and supporting infrastructure provisioning under Kubernetes with Crossplane.

Feb 2024 — Jul 2025

Regask

Senior Software Engineer

Go · Node.js · Azure · Okta · SAML · OIDC

  • Architected a highly available Azure platform with redundancy and failover across every critical component.
  • Rewrote memory-bound Node.js services in Go, reducing memory per service from 1.5 GB to 400–500 MB.
  • Delivered enterprise SSO with Okta across SAML and OIDC, unifying authentication between services.
  • Introduced Technical Solution Documents and structured code reviews for 5–7 engineers, shortening review cycles and reducing production bugs.
